visualPolishDesc: HOI4 visual decoration fields. They don't affect logic — leave them blank and nothing exports. Most mods don't need them.
textIconDesc: Decorative text GFX beside the node title. Leave it blank and nothing renders. Maps to vanilla `text_icon = X`.
customIconShipNote: To ship a custom GFX here, upload it to the project icon library under that exact name (or pick a vanilla one). A name with no matching image is dropped at export to avoid a broken icon.
offsetDesc: Each row is one <mono>offset</mono> block that moves the node to a different (x,y) under different country triggers — common in shared focus trees. Leave it empty and nothing exports.
dynamicIconDesc: Switch the node icon by trigger (vanilla<mono> dynamic_icon</mono>). The first match wins; trigger = always is the fallback. Leave it empty and nothing exports.
nameHint: The name on the focus tree node and its tooltip. Leave it empty and a new focus shows its raw focus_id; a focus that reuses a vanilla id keeps the vanilla name.
iconPlaceholder: GFX_goal_unknown · pick from the icon library on the right
iconLibraryTitle: Browse the vanilla / project-existing icon library
availableLabel: available (unlock condition — focus is greyed out and unclickable when unmet)
bypassLabel: bypass (skip condition — focus is auto-skipped when met · trigger block)
bypassEffectLabel: bypass_effect (effect run when the focus is skipped — compensate the player / trigger story)
bypassEffectPlaceholder:
# e.g. compensate the player when the focus is skipped
add_political_power = 50
add_stability = 0.05
cancelLabel: cancel (cancel condition — cancels an in-progress focus when met)
selectEffectHint: Fires the moment this focus is selected (not on completion). Use for lock-in-branch flags / immediate setup. completion_reward fires ~70 days later when the focus completes.
positionCollisionTitle: Two focuses at the same coordinate stack invisibly in the focus tree UI.
prereqLogicNote: Each group is AND logic. Multiple focus IDs within a group = OR logic. Comma-separated.
cancelIfInvalidHint: Auto-cancel the in-progress focus if its available condition turns false (default on).
continueIfInvalidHint: Keep progressing even if available turns false mid-completion (default off).
availableIfCapitulatedHint: Allow this focus to be completed while your country has capitulated (default off).
willLeadToWarWithHint: Marks the focus as leading to war with a country — adds a wargoal / war-warning against each TAG on completion. One line per target on export.
preservedFieldsNote: These fields were imported from the original file and are preserved in export.
effectTooltipHint: Plain-language tooltip for the completion_reward. Effects like add_to_variable / set_country_flag show no automatic tooltip in-game — type the text here and export auto-inserts custom_effect_tooltip into the reward block and ships the loc text.
uploadHint: PNG / JPG / DDS · 68 × 68 · auto-converted to DDS at export · auto-named GFX_focus_[focus_id]
